| [TERM-089](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-089.md) v2 | apparatus, in the operational sense: a realized organization that selectively couples differences in one system to distinguishable outcomes in another; by function it may differentiate, retain, enforce and revise, and the four come apart | The sense of "apparatus" the exchange of 2026-10-27 converged on from U19 to U23, stated so that no observer and no constitutive metaphysics is presupposed. | [TERM-092](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-092.md) v3 | inquiry frontier, of an agent at a budget: the questions it can formulate, making them determinate enough to pursue, with the concepts, records, tools, time and computation it actually has; distinct from the questions its language can express, from those it can pursue to a stated standard, and from those that have answers | The object of [CLAIM-475](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-475.md), from A17 §§2 and 7 of the exchange of 2026-10-27. A question is on an agent's frontier if some procedure available to it, within its budget and horizon, makes the question determinate enough to pursue. Formulating counts against the budget as well as answering. The frontier moves when resources grow and when reusable specifications make formulation cheaper, and it can change shape as well as size. The term separates askable from expressible and from answerable, which [CLAIM-474](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-474.md)'s last failure turns on. | Active |
